# Dogfood note: s09 (the prime's operating picture), pm-001

pij-steady-otter, 2026-11-07 18:50 AEST, after #141 merged at acf3646 (daemon pid 7956). Ran `pij directory --project pij-fleet` once.

## Worked
- The prime line, each role's live holders, latest output (s06) and memory count (s07) in one view; cold docs-system shows a runnable `call_on`.
- Next actions are runnable, quoted and name the project.
- The C28 recommendation (`cli`, recurring across s04, s06, s09, s11) names its signal.

## Findings
- **F80 (low).** The scratch `s05-probe` role still has one request queued from the s05 dogfood (2026-11-06 18:39), so the view's next actions keep proposing `pij-rs revive pij-wooden-lungfish` or an assign for a role that does no work. Today there's no way to clear it: `pij requests withdraw` is #149 (plan 212) and retire is #135 (s15). Owner: clears once either lands. Then withdraw the request and retire s05-probe.
- **F81 (low).** The boundary review's two-domains signal fires on pij-swift-kestrel for holding delivery plus coder/212 and coder/214. Those plans are inside delivery's own scope (`crates/daemon/src/delivery/**`), so it is one domain, not two. Fix: don't count a coder/<plan> holding as a second domain when the plan's paths fall in the holder's specialist scope (or when the coder holding names that role). Owner: an s09 follow-up, unowned for now.
